mentions.name: Holdem Puzzles
mentions.description: A free poker training web app designed to help players place highly in WSOP or WPT satellite tournaments in order to qualify for the main tournaments.
mentions.problem: Qualifying for main WSOP or WPT tournaments requires placing high enough in satellite tournaments, which the target user needs help achieving.
mentions.audience: Wants to place high enough in a WSOP or WPT satellite tournament to qualify for the main tournaments; specifically built for a friend (JG) but other poker players can use it too
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building a free poker training web app, specifically aimed my friend JG who wants to place sufficiently high enough in a WSOP or WPT satellite tournament to qualify for the main tournaments:   https://holdempuzzles.com/

evidence.value: I am building a free poker training web app, specifically aimed my friend JG who wants to place sufficiently high enough in a WSOP or WPT satellite tournament to qualify for the main tournaments:   https://holdempuzzles.com/
